notes: Created report id=10393, identifier=SC-492, title '__mcp-probe-report-20260921', created_at 2026-09-21T13:34:14.395Z, in project 379335744 (PR-2005). DECLARED-MISSING (DRIFT): the 200 schema marks data.mail_to as required, but it is absent from the actual response entirely (not null, not present) — shallowest missing path is data.mail_to. UNDECLARED-RETURNED: seven extra keys on data (see contract.undeclared_returned) that the schema never mentions, including project_ids/included_projects (a second, array-shaped project representation alongside the declared singular project_id) and three schedule/slack-adjacent fields. None of these break usage but the schema is visibly behind the live response shape. SCHEDULE-VS-REPORT IDENTITY (for delete_report_schedule / update_report / download_report / send_report_email_now_v1): this report was created deliberately UNSCHEDULED — no frequency, frequency_details or mail_to were sent, matching guidance that a report is scheduled iff both frequency and frequency_details are present. The response confirms: frequency=null, frequency_details=null, next_run_at=null, and no mail_to key. There is NO separate 'schedule' object or id anywhere in this response or in list_schedules — a report and its schedule are the SAME record; id=10393 / identifier=SC-492 is the only id that exists, and scheduling is just a set of fields (frequency/frequency_details/next_run_at/mail_to) on that same report row. This means delete_report_schedule almost certainly does not delete a distinct entity — there is nothing with its own id for it to target beyond the report id itself; it most likely clears/nulls the schedule fields on the report record (unverified — not probed here, left to that capability's own probe run). This also means a created report cannot be 'cleaned up' via delete_report_schedule; only a genuine delete/destructive report capability (not present in this index under an obvious name) or leaving it in __mcp-capability-fixture__ as residue (as the three pre-existing reports already are) would apply. EMAIL PATH: deliberately unexercised. No users/external_mails/frequency/frequency_details were sent, so mail_to was never populated and no email was sent or could have been sent (guidance: mail_to is only persisted for a scheduled report, and this one is not scheduled). send_report_email_now_v1 should be probed as its own capability with that decision made explicitly by whoever runs it. COUNT-VS-ROWS: list_schedules returned total_report_count=3 and exactly 3 rows in data — no disagreement, and this also corrects the pool file's stale claim of 1 pre-existing report (there were 3, all created 2026-09-18, before this probe's new report 10393 / SC-492 created 2026-09-21T13:34:14.395Z). Verdict is DRIFT rather than PASS solely due to the missing declared-required data.mail_to field; everything else about the create behaved as documented (200 not 201, data holds the definition only with no report_data, project echoed as a full object).
